summary: The mesh matches the concept's front in most parts, but two assertions fail (holes 17/10, trouser navy kept 0.052/0.063), the face reads faintly, the back shows a plain leather panel where the brief wants crossing straps, and the wireframe shows long spike edges.

findings.observation: Long stray edges in the wireframe at the waist, wrists and head, not visible in shaded views. (Orchestrator note: on the same raw P2 mesh the longest edge measured ~0.1 m in the A/B, so these are most likely a wireframe-render artefact.)
The back of the torso is a plain leather panel with no crossing harness straps, which the brief names as an identity mark.
Eyes are dark smudges, brows faint, mouth barely visible; only the nose reads.
Holes 17 vs 10 (body 7 loops, one part 3, others 1), possibly expected for a shell-built body; none visible.
Trouser navy keeps 0.052 vs 0.063 of the texture but still shows.

escalation_reason: Unrelated fixes: spike edges (likely render artefact), back straps (concept gap), faint face (texture resolution), and the hole count may be misleading for a shell-built spike asset. None is a single concept edit or reroll.
